sql: SELECT TOP 1 p.StoreCode AS storeCode, p.PortalId AS portalId, MAX(f.widgetsKey) AS widgetKey, COUNT(f.sku) AS productCount, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos1 THEN f.sku END) AS product1Sku, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos1 THEN f.productId END) AS product1Id, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos1 THEN f.name END) AS product1Name, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos2 THEN f.sku END) AS product2Sku, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos2 THEN f.productId END) AS product2Id, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos2 THEN f.name END) AS product2Name, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos3 THEN f.sku END) AS product3Sku, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos3 THEN f.productId END) AS product3Id, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos3 THEN f.name END) AS product3Name, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos4 THEN f.sku END) AS product4Sku, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos4 THEN f.productId END) AS product4Id, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos4 THEN f.name END) AS product4Name FROM dbo.ZnodePortal p INNER JOIN (SELECT k.portalId, k.widgetsKey, k.sku, k.productId, k.name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k.portalId ORDER BY k.displayOrder, k.widgetRowId) AS position FROM (SELECT w.PortalId AS portalId, w.WidgetsKey AS widgetsKey, w.SKU AS sku, pr.productId AS productId, pr.name AS name, w.DisplayOrder AS displayOrder, w.PublishWidgetProductEntityId AS widgetRowId, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.PortalId ORDER BY CHARINDEX(w.WidgetsKey, pp.PageJSON), w.WidgetsKey) AS widgetRank FROM dbo.ZnodePublishWidgetProductEntity w INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishWebstoreEntity ws ON ws.VersionId = w.VersionId AND ws.PortalId = w.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCMSPortalProfilePageMapper pm ON pm.PortalId = w.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCMSPortalPages pp ON pp.CMSPortalPageId = pm.CMSPortalPageId CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 pe.ZnodeProductId AS productId, pe.Name AS name FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity v ON v.VersionId = pe.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = pe.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE pe.SKU = w.SKU AND pc.PortalId = w.PortalId AND pe.LocaleId = @localeId AND pe.IsActive = @isActive AND v.RevisionType = @publishState AND v.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND v.LocaleId = @localeId ORDER BY pe.PublishProductEntityId DESC) pr WHERE ws.PublishState = @publishState AND ws.LocaleId = @localeId AND w.TypeOFMapping = @portalMapping AND w.MappingId = w.PortalId AND pm.PageCode = @homePageCode AND pm.ProfileId IS NULL AND CHARINDEX(w.WidgetsKey, pp.PageJSON) > @zero) k WHERE k.widgetRank = @pos1) f ON f.portalId = p.PortalId WHERE p.StoreCode = @store GROUP BY p.PortalId, p.StoreCode HAVING (@minProducts IS NULL OR COUNT(f.sku) >= @minProducts) ORDER BY p.PortalId
